comment: The point jacks are all monophonic, Osc1.cpp:178 and Osc1.cpp:187, so one voltage moves that point for every voice. There are sixteen height jacks for the sixteen points but only fourteen place jacks, because the first and last points are held at the two ends of the cycle. A jack past the current Length setting is passed over, Osc1.cpp:175-176 and Osc1.cpp:184-185. Neither output is computed while both are unpatched, Osc1.cpp:200. The maker's summary describes the module as alias suppressing, which is the sixteen times oversampling at Osc1.cpp:221.
